candidates.name: Military cable
candidates.rationale: A bounded military-grade logistics component fits Admiral's expeditionary procurement role and does not directly grant combat capability. The pinned fixed-trader SPT 4.1.3 assort set contains no direct Military cable offer, unlike the rejected repair/tool candidates. The proposed envelope deliberately prices above the pinned 28,413 RUB reference and remains finite; Economy Admiral still owns final price/supply approval.

candidates.name: Military circuit board
candidates.rationale: The item is thematically appropriate but pinned Mechanic assort uses it repeatedly as barter input. Turning standing into a renewable direct source would weaken existing barter scarcity rather than create an independent Relationship privilege.

candidates.name: Phased array element
candidates.rationale: The item fits high-tier military electronics but is already consumed by pinned Mechanic barter schemes, including high-count recipes. Stable Relationship supply would materially bypass another trader's barter economy and is rejected before runtime materialization.

candidates.name: Toolset
candidates.rationale: Pinned SPT 4.1.3 Mechanic assort directly contains the Toolset with unlimited stock. Relationship progression should not spend a slot duplicating an already-renewable vanilla source.

candidates.name: Weapon repair kit
candidates.rationale: Pinned SPT 4.1.3 Ref assort already contains the weapon repair kit with unlimited stock. Admiral may only use it later if the relationship role supplies a deliberately bounded alternative with a justified access distinction; it is not approved for materialization now. Exact repository-wide searches also found no direct tpl reference in the currently pinned Scorpion/Artem source mirrors, so the hold is driven by vanilla redundancy rather than a hidden cross-mod collision.

candidates.name: Body armor repair kit
candidates.rationale: Pinned SPT 4.1.3 Ref assort already provides this item with unlimited stock and its reference value is exceptionally high. Duplicating it would add both overlap and large economic pressure without a unique Admiral capability story. Exact repository-wide searches found no direct tpl reference in the currently pinned Scorpion/Artem source mirrors, so no external-mod exception changes the rejection.

candidates.name: Leatherman Multitool
candidates.rationale: Pinned SPT 4.1.3 Mechanic assort directly exposes the multitool with unlimited stock; adding it as relationship progression would create low-value duplicate availability rather than a meaningful Admiral privilege.

candidates.name: Signal Jammer
candidates.rationale: Pinned SPT 4.1.3 Mechanic assort directly exposes the jammer with unlimited stock. It is also a vanilla quest-placement tool, so Admiral duplication would be convenience stock rather than relationship progression.

namedRejectedEquipment.name: Tripwire installation kit
namedRejectedEquipment.rationale: Tripwire is a direct grenade/trap combat capability and vanilla acquisition is deliberately quest-unlocked through Jaeger. Relationship standing must not bypass that capability gate.

namedRejectedEquipment.name: Radio repeater
namedRejectedEquipment.rationale: Radio repeater is a purpose-built placement item tied to Network Provider progression and its Workbench craft. Renewable Admiral stock would short-circuit another progression path rather than add independent logistics value.

namedRejectedEquipment.name: Local network hacking device
namedRejectedEquipment.rationale: The hacking device is explicitly provided/used by story and quest progression and has a Mechanic acquisition path. Relationship stock must not replace story-state acquisition.

namedRejectedEquipment.name: The Eye mortar strike signaling device
namedRejectedEquipment.rationale: The Eye is a unique functional quest reward, not ordinary specialist merchandise. Making it renewable would erase the meaning of its quest reward.

namedRejectedEquipment.name: Audio recorder
namedRejectedEquipment.rationale: The recorder is used as story/quest equipment and has no normal trader/flea availability. No independent recurring logistics use has been proven that would justify Relationship materialization.

namedRejectedEquipment.name: SZ-1 explosive charge
namedRejectedEquipment.rationale: Explosive charges are direct capability items, outside Relationship convenience/logistics authority and unsuitable as standing-only stock.
